visual.title: Each operation keeps every solution
visual.caption: Step through the elimination. Every row operation replaces one equation by a combination of both, which is why the pair of values that solves the system survives a change that rewrites the equations.

predict.question: After replacing R2 by R2 + R1, how many solutions does the new system have?
options: One, the same solution as before
predict.explain: Adding a multiple of one equation to another is reversible, so it cannot create or destroy a solution.
